# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggalluvial)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(eulerr)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(writexl)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(ggridges)
library(grid)
```

# Load data

```{r}
hpa_data <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.25/hpa_evidence_v25.csv")
head(hpa_data)

hpa_data_v24 <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.24/hpa_data_v24.csv")
head(hpa_data_v24)

tissue_data <- read_tsv("../data/HPA v.24/rna_tissue_consensus.tsv")
head(tissue_data)

uniprot_data <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.25/uniprot_v24.csv")
head(uniprot_data)
```

# Check data

```{r}
hpa_data |> distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(Ensembl, `HPA evidence`) |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, Gene, `Gene description`, Uniprot, Chromosome), by = "Ensembl") |>
  full_join(uniprot_data |> select(Ensembl, UniProt_gene = Gene, `UniProts uniprot` = UniProt, `Uniprot evidence`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  count(`HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`, name = "Number of genes") 

hpa_data |> distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(Ensembl, `HPA evidence`) |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, Gene, `Gene description`, Uniprot, Chromosome), by = "Ensembl") |>
  full_join(uniprot_data |> select(Ensembl, UniProt_gene = Gene, `UniProts uniprot` = UniProt, `Uniprot evidence`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  # UniProt entry
  mutate(`Uniprot evidence` = case_when(
    is.na(`Uniprot evidence`) ~ "No UniProt entry",
    TRUE ~ `Uniprot evidence`
  )) |>
  # HPA entry
  mutate(`HPA evidence` = case_when(
    is.na(`HPA evidence`) ~ "No HPA entry",
    TRUE ~ `HPA evidence`
  )) %T>%
  count(`HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`, name = "Number of genes") 

hpa_data |> distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(Ensembl, `HPA evidence`) |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, Gene, `Gene description`, Uniprot, Chromosome), by = "Ensembl") |>
  full_join(uniprot_data |> select(Ensembl, UniProt_gene = Gene, `UniProts uniprot` = UniProt, `Uniprot evidence`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  # UniProt entry
  mutate(`Uniprot evidence` = case_when(
    is.na(`Uniprot evidence`) ~ "No UniProt entry",
    TRUE ~ `Uniprot evidence`
  )) |>
  # HPA entry
  mutate(`HPA evidence` = case_when(
    is.na(`HPA evidence`) ~ "No HPA entry",
    TRUE ~ `HPA evidence`
  )) |>
  filter(`HPA evidence` == "No HPA entry" | `Uniprot evidence` == "No UniProt entry") |>
  write_xlsx("../tables/Figure 3/hpa_uniprot_no_entry.xlsx")
```

# Plots

## Sankey: Comparing HPA and UniProt evidence

```{r}
# Colors
hpa_colors_all <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level"                       = "darkgreen",
  "Evidence at transcript level"                    = "darkorange",
  "No human protein/transcript evidence"            = "firebrick"
)

uniprot_colors_all <- c(
  "Experimental evidence at protein level (PE1)"    = "darkgreen",
  "Experimental evidence at transcript level (PE2)" = "darkorange",
  "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)"            = "#cccccc", 
  "Protein predicted (PE4)"                         = "#999999", 
  "Protein uncertain (PE5)"                         = "#888888",  
  "No UniProt entry"                                = "#444444"
)

# Levels
uniprot_levels_all <- c(
  "No UniProt entry",
  "No evidence",
  "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
  "Protein predicted (PE4)",
  "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)",
  "Experimental evidence at transcript level (PE2)",
  "Experimental evidence at protein level (PE1)"
)

hpa_levels_all <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level",
  "Evidence at transcript level",
  "No human protein/transcript evidence",
  "No HPA entry")

hpa_levels_all <- rev(hpa_levels_all)

# Plotting
sankey_data <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  full_join(uniprot_data |> select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  # UniProt no entry
  mutate(`Uniprot evidence` = case_when (is.na(`Uniprot evidence`) ~ "No UniProt entry",
                                               TRUE ~ `Uniprot evidence`))  |>
  filter(!is.na(`HPA evidence`)) |>
  count(`HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`, name = "Freq")

evidence_colors <- c(hpa_colors_all, uniprot_colors_all)

sankey_data <- sankey_data %>%
  mutate(
    `HPA evidence`     = factor(`HPA evidence`, levels = hpa_levels_all),
    `Uniprot evidence` = factor(`Uniprot evidence`, levels = uniprot_levels_all)
  )

sankey_data_label <- sankey_data %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`),
    names_to = "axis",
    values_to = "stratum"
  ) %>%
  group_by(axis, stratum) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(Freq), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(stratum, "\n(", count, ")"))

ggplot(sankey_data,
       aes(axis1 = `HPA evidence`,
           axis2 = `Uniprot evidence`,
           y     = Freq)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = `HPA evidence`), width = 0.4, alpha = 0.8,
                color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)),
               width = 0.5,
               color = "black"
  )  +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(
      label = after_stat(
        paste0(stratum, "\n(", ..count.., ")")
      )
    ),
    size = 4,
    vjust = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("HPA Evidence", "UniProt Evidence"),
    expand = c(0.05, 0.05)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = evidence_colors, na.value = "#999999") +
  labs(
    title = "Sankey Plot of HPA and UniProt Evidence Categories",
    y = "Number of Genes",
    fill = "Evidence Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3A.pdf", width = 16, height = 24, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3A.png", width = 16, height = 24, dpi = 300)
```

## Sankey: Highlighting only genes that have no UniProt evidence

```{r}
# Colors
hpa_colors_all <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level"                       = "darkgreen",
  "Evidence at transcript level"                    = "darkorange",
  "No human protein/transcript evidence"            = "firebrick",
  "No HPA entry"                                    = "#444444"
)

uniprot_colors_all <- c(
  "Experimental evidence at protein level (PE1)"    = "darkgreen",
  "Experimental evidence at transcript level (PE2)" = "darkorange",
  "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)"            = "#cccccc", 
  "Protein predicted (PE4)"                         = "#999999", 
  "Protein uncertain (PE5)"                         = "#888888",  
  "No UniProt entry"                                = "#444444"
)

evidence_colors <- c(hpa_colors_all, uniprot_colors_all)

# Levels
uniprot_levels_all <- c(
  "No UniProt entry",
  "No evidence",
  "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
  "Protein predicted (PE4)",
  "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)",
  "Experimental evidence at transcript level (PE2)",
  "Experimental evidence at protein level (PE1)"
)

hpa_levels_all <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level",
  "Evidence at transcript level",
  "No human protein/transcript evidence",
  "No HPA entry")

hpa_levels_all <- rev(hpa_levels_all)

# Plotting
sankey_data <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  full_join(uniprot_data |> select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  mutate(`Uniprot evidence` = case_when (is.na(`Uniprot evidence`) ~ "No UniProt entry",
                                               TRUE ~ `Uniprot evidence`)) |>
  filter(`Uniprot evidence` %in% c("No UniProt entry", "Protein uncertain (PE5)", "Protein predicted (PE4)", "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)")) |>
  filter(!`HPA evidence` %in% c("No human protein/transcript evidence", "No HPA entry")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`HPA evidence`)) %>%
  count(`HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`, name = "Freq")

sankey_data <- sankey_data %>%
  mutate(
    `Uniprot evidence` = factor(
      `Uniprot evidence`,
      levels = c(
        "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)",
        "Protein predicted (PE4)",
        "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
        "No human protein/transcript evidence",
        "No UniProt entry"
      )
    )
  )

total_genes <- sum(sankey_data$Freq)

ggplot(sankey_data,
       aes(
         axis1 = `Uniprot evidence`,
         axis2 = `HPA evidence`,
         y     = Freq
       )
) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = `Uniprot evidence`),
                width = 0.4, alpha = 0.8,
                color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)),
               width = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(paste0(stratum, "\n(", ..count.., ")"))),
    size = 4, vjust = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("UniProt", "HPA"),
    labels = c("UniProt Evidence", "HPA Evidence"),
    expand = c(0.05, 0.05)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = evidence_colors, na.value = "#999999") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("HPA contributing genes v.25 (n = %d)", total_genes),
    y     = "Number of Genes",
    fill  = "Evidence Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  guides(fill = FALSE)

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3B.pdf", width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3B.png", width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```


## Dataset contribution

### Venn: Protein level evidence

```{r}
hpa_contributing_proteins <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_data %>% select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`),
    by = "Ensembl"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Uniprot evidence` = coalesce(`Uniprot evidence`, "No UniProt entry")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    `Uniprot evidence` %in% c(
      "No UniProt entry",
      "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
      "Protein predicted (PE4)",
      "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)"
    ),
    `HPA evidence` == "Evidence at protein level"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl)

wf    <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(
    Ensembl %in% hpa_contributing_proteins,
    Dataset == "Western blot",
    Evidence_type == "Western blot evidence"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl) %>% unique()

icc <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(
    Ensembl %in% hpa_contributing_proteins,
    Dataset == "immunocytochemistry",
    Evidence_type == "immunocytochemistry evidence"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl) %>% unique()

ihc   <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(
    Ensembl %in% hpa_contributing_proteins,
    Dataset == "Immunohistochemistry",
    Evidence_type == "Immunohistochemistry evidence"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl) %>% unique()

venn_data <- list(
  `Western blot`          = wf,
  `immunocytochemistry`    = icc,
  `Immunohistochemistry`  = ihc
)

print(length(wf))
print(length(icc))
print(length(ihc))

common_all <- Reduce(intersect, venn_data)
print(common_all)

venn_fit <- euler(venn_data)

venn_plot <- plot(
  venn_fit,
  fills      = list(
    `Western blot`         = "#75B2E9",
    `immunocytochemistry`   = "#FE625E",
    `Immunohistochemistry` = "#E8BCAD"
  ),
  quantities = TRUE,
  labels     = TRUE,
  main       = "HPA Protein‐Level Evidence Venn"
)

print(venn_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = "../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3C.pdf",
  plot     = venn_plot, 
  width    = 8, 
  height   = 6, 
  dpi      = 300,
  device   = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  filename = "../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3C.png",
  plot     = venn_plot,
  width    = 8,
  height   = 6,
  dpi      = 300,
  device   = "png"
)
```

```{r}
wb_contributing <- venn_data$`Western blot` |> as.data.frame() |> rename(Ensembl = "venn_data$`Western blot`") |>
  mutate(WB = "Yes")
icc_contibuting <- venn_data$immunocytochemistry |> as.data.frame() |> rename(Ensembl = "venn_data$immunocytochemistry") |>
  mutate(ICC = "Yes")
ihc_contributing <- venn_data$Immunohistochemistry |> as.data.frame() |> rename(Ensembl = "venn_data$Immunohistochemistry") |>
  mutate(IHC = "Yes")

wb_contributing |>
  full_join(icc_contibuting, by = "Ensembl") |>
  full_join(ihc_contributing, by = "Ensembl") |> 
  mutate(
    WB = coalesce(WB, "No"),
    ICC = coalesce(ICC, "No"),
    IHC = coalesce(IHC, "No")
  ) |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, Gene, `Gene synonym`, `Gene description`, Uniprot, Chromosome), by = "Ensembl") |>
  write_xlsx("../tables/Figure 3/venn_contributing_proteins.xlsx")
```

### Upset: Transcript level evidence

```{r}
hpa_contributing_transcripts <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_data %>% select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`),
    by = "Ensembl"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Uniprot evidence` = coalesce(`Uniprot evidence`, "No UniProt entry")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    `Uniprot evidence` %in% c(
      "No UniProt entry",
      "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
      "Protein predicted (PE4)",
      "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)"
    ),
    `HPA evidence` == "Evidence at transcript level"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl)

rna_datasets <- c("Tissue", "Brain", "Cell type", "Immune cell type", "Cell line")

upset_base <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% rna_datasets) %>%
  filter(Ensembl %in% hpa_contributing_transcripts)
  

upset_data <- upset_base %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, Evidence_type) %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Evidence_type, values_from = value, values_fill = 0)

set_order <- c("Tissue evidence", "Brain evidence", "Cell type evidence", "Immune cell type evidence", "Cell line evidence")
set_order <- rev(set_order)
upset_data <- upset_data[, c("Ensembl", set_order)]

upset_contributing_transcripts <- ComplexUpset::upset(
  upset_data,
  intersect = set_order,
  base_annotations = list(
    'Number of genes' = intersection_size(
      text = list(
        size     = 4,
        vjust    = -0.5,
        fontface = "bold",
        color    = "black"
      )
    )
  ),
  set_sizes = (
    upset_set_size(position = "right") +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = ..count..),
        stat = "count",
        hjust = 1,
        size = 4,
        color = "white",
        fontface = "bold"
      ) 
  ),
  width_ratio = 0.3,
  sort_sets = FALSE,
  guides = "over"
)

upset_contributing_transcripts

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3D.pdf", width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3D.png", width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
upset_data |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, Gene, `Gene synonym`, `Gene description`, Uniprot, Chromosome), by = "Ensembl") |>
  write_xlsx("../tables/Figure 3/upset_contributing_transcripts.xlsx")
```

## Bar: Enrichment

```{r}
hpa_data_v24 %>%
  select(Ensembl, `RNA tissue specificity`, `RNA single cell type specificity`, `RNA blood cell specificity`, `RNA brain regional specificity`, `RNA cell line specificity`) |>
  filter(Ensembl %in% c(hpa_contributing_transcripts, hpa_contributing_proteins)) 
```

```{r}
# --- colors & factor levels
spec_colors <- c(
  "Dataset enriched"        = "#E31A1B",
  "Group enriched"          = "#FE9D00",
  "Dataset enhanced"        = "#B65EC4",
  "Low dataset specificity" = "#7D7D7D",
  "Not detected"            = "#E4E4E4"
)
spec_levels <- c("Dataset enriched", "Group enriched", "Dataset enhanced",
                 "Low dataset specificity", "Not detected")

# Dataset name mapping
dataset_labels <- c(
  "RNA tissue specificity"             = "Tissue",
  "RNA single cell type specificity"   = "Single cell type",
  "RNA blood cell specificity"         = "Immune cell",
  "RNA brain regional specificity"     = "Brain region",
  "RNA cell line specificity"          = "Cell line"
)

# Prettier HPA evidence labels
hpa_labels <- c(
  "Evidence at transcript level" = "Transcript\nEvidence",
  "Evidence at protein level"    = "Protein\nEvidence"
)

# --- Prepare data
rna_long <- hpa_data_v24 %>%
  select(
    Ensembl, `HPA evidence`,
    `RNA tissue specificity`,
    `RNA single cell type specificity`,
    `RNA blood cell specificity`,
    `RNA brain regional specificity`,
    `RNA cell line specificity`
  ) %>%
  filter(Ensembl %in% ens_keep) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(Ensembl, `HPA evidence`), as.character)) %>%
  mutate(`RNA tissue specificity` = recode(`RNA tissue specificity`,
    "Tissue enriched" = "Dataset enriched",
    "Tissue enhanced" = "Dataset enhanced",
    "Low tissue specificity" = "Low dataset specificity"
  ),
  `RNA single cell type specificity` = recode(`RNA single cell type specificity`,
    "Cell type enriched" = "Dataset enriched",
    "Cell type enhanced" = "Dataset enhanced",
    "Low cell type specificity" = "Low dataset specificity"
  ),
  `RNA blood cell specificity` = recode(`RNA blood cell specificity`,
    "Immune cell enriched" = "Dataset enriched",
    "Immune cell enhanced" = "Dataset enhanced",
    "Low immune cell specificity" = "Low dataset specificity",
    "Not detected in immune cells" = "Not detected"
  ),
  `RNA brain regional specificity` = recode(`RNA brain regional specificity`,
    "Region enriched" = "Dataset enriched",
    "Region enhanced" = "Dataset enhanced",
    "Low region specificity" = "Low dataset specificity"
  ),
  `RNA cell line specificity` = recode(`RNA cell line specificity`,
    "Cancer enriched" = "Dataset enriched",
    "Cancer enhanced" = "Dataset enhanced",
    "Low cancer specificity" = "Low dataset specificity"
  )) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Ensembl, `HPA evidence`),
    names_to = "Dataset",
    values_to = "Specificity"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Dataset     = recode(Dataset, !!!dataset_labels),
    Specificity = factor(Specificity, levels = spec_levels),
    `HPA evidence` = factor(`HPA evidence`,
      levels = c("Evidence at transcript level", "Evidence at protein level")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(`HPA evidence` %in% levels(`HPA evidence`))

# --- Counts per Dataset x Evidence x Specificity
counts_lbl <- rna_long %>%
  group_by(Dataset, `HPA evidence`, Specificity) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(Ensembl), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(Dataset, `HPA evidence`, Specificity,
           fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(n > 0, paste0("n = ", n), ""))

# --- Plot: side-by-side bars within dataset facets
p_side_by_side <- ggplot(counts_lbl, aes(x = `HPA evidence`, y = n, fill = Specificity)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.55, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3.0, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Dataset, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = hpa_labels, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = spec_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Number of genes", fill = "Specificity",
    title = "Stacked counts by specificity: Transcript vs Protein evidence (per dataset)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 10, b = 5, l = 10)
  )

p_side_by_side

# Save plots
ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3E.pdf", p_side_by_side, width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3E.png", p_side_by_side, width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## nTPM per dataset

### Density plot

```{r}
# 1) Filter based on Ensembl IDs in filtered_ensembl
df_ridges_filtered <- hpa_data |>
  filter(
    Ensembl %in% ens_keep,
    !Dataset %in% c("immunocytochemistry", "Western blot", "Immunohistochemistry"),
    `HPA evidence` %in% c("Evidence at transcript level", "Evidence at protein level")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    `HPA evidence` = factor(
      `HPA evidence`,
      levels = c("Evidence at transcript level", "Evidence at protein level")
    )
  )

# 2) Plot
ggplot(df_ridges_filtered,
       aes(x = log10(max_ntpm + 1), y = `HPA evidence`, fill = `HPA evidence`)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_density_ridges(rel_min_height = 0.01, scale = 1.2, alpha = 0.8, color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ Dataset, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Evidence at transcript level" = "darkorange",
      "Evidence at protein level"    = "darkgreen"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Filtered genes: Distribution of log10(max nTPM) by HPA evidence and Dataset",
    x = "log10(max nTPM + 1)",
    y = "HPA evidence",
    fill = "HPA evidence"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3F.pdf", width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3F.png", width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## Bars

### Tissue

```{r}
# 1. Filter to genes of interest
hpa_data_filt <- hpa_data_v24 %>%
  filter(Ensembl %in% ens_keep)

# 2. Expand the tissue/nTPM string into long format
hpa_long_filt <- hpa_data_filt %>%
  filter(!is.na(`RNA tissue specific nTPM`)) %>%
  mutate(
    tissue_value = str_split(`RNA tissue specific nTPM`, ";")
  ) %>%
  unnest(tissue_value) %>%
  mutate(
    tissue_value = str_trim(tissue_value),
    tissue = str_extract(tissue_value, "^[^:]+"),
    nTPM = as.numeric(str_extract(tissue_value, "(?<=: )\\d+\\.?\\d*"))
  )

# 3. For each Ensembl, keep only the tissue with the max nTPM
hpa_max_filt <- hpa_long_filt %>%
  group_by(Ensembl) %>%
  filter(nTPM == max(nTPM, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # in case of ties
  ungroup()

# 4. Plot
ggplot(hpa_max_filt, aes(x = tissue, fill = `HPA evidence`)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack") +
  labs(
    title = "Filtered genes: Number per tissue (by max nTPM), colored by HPA evidence",
    x = "Tissue",
    y = "Number of genes"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Evidence at protein level" = "darkgreen",
      "Evidence at transcript level" = "darkorange"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3G.pdf", width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3G.png", width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

## HPA contributing genes

```{r}
hpa_contributing_genes <- hpa_data |> 
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  full_join(
    uniprot_data |> select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`),
    by = "Ensembl"
  ) |>
  filter(`HPA evidence` == "Evidence at protein level" | `HPA evidence` == "Evidence at transcript level") |>
  filter(`Uniprot evidence` == "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)" | 
           `Uniprot evidence` == "Protein predicted (PE4)" | 
           `Uniprot evidence` == "Protein uncertain (PE5)" |
           `Uniprot evidence` == "No human protein/transcript evidence") 

hpa_data |> 
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  full_join(
    uniprot_data |> select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`),

  filter(`HPA evidence` != "No human protein/transcript evidence" & `Uniprot evidence` != "No human protein/transcript evidence") |>
  filter(`HPA evidence` != "No human protein/transcript evidence" & `Uniprot evidence` != "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)") |>
  filter(`HPA evidence` != "No human protein/transcript evidence" & `Uniprot evidence` != "Protein predicted (PE4) ") |>
  filter(`HPA evidence` != "No human protein/transcript evidence" & `Uniprot evidence` != "Protein uncertain (PE5)")

  filter(`HPA evidence` == "Evidence at protein level" & `Uniprot evidence` == "Experimental evidence at protein level (PE1)" |
```

```{r}
# Seek overlapping Ensembl from multi_target_data and hpa_contributing_genes
hpa_contributing_genes |>
  select(-Gene) |>
  full_join(multi_target_data |> select(-Gene) |> mutate(multi_target = "Multi target"), by = "Ensembl") |>
  filter(!is.na(Dataset)) |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, Gene, `RNA tissue specificity`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  select(Ensembl, Gene, `HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`, `Evidence annotation (transcript)`, `Evidence annotation (protein)`, multi_target, `RNA tissue specificity`) |>
  write_xlsx("../tables/Figure 3/HPA contributing genes v.25.xlsx")
```
